CS.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(CS.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (CS.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR CS.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND CS.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND CS.TARGET_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) SHARE_TARGET_TYPES, CASE WHEN #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NOT NULL AND PP.CREATED_BY = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES CS WHERE CS.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND CS.CONTENT_ID = PP.POST_ID AND CS.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(CS.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (CS.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR CS.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND CS.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_SHARED_BY_ME, (SELECT LISTAGG(TO_CHAR(CS.TARGET_ID), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CS.TARGET_ID) FROM CONTENT_SHARES CS WHERE CS.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND CS.CONTENT_ID = PP.POST_ID AND CS.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(CS.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (CS.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR CS.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND CS.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND PP.CREATED_BY = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}) mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM PHOTO_POSTS PP JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = PP.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN PHOTO_ALBUMS A ON A.ALBUM_ID = PP.ALBUM_ID WHERE ( (PP.SCOPE_TYPE = #{scopeType} AND PP.SCOPE_ID = #{scopeId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'PERSONAL' AND PP.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' AND NVL(PP.VISIBILITY_TYPE, 'PRIVATE') = 'FRIENDS' AND PP.CREATED_BY <> #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_FRIENDS UF WHERE UF.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (UF.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND UF.ADDRESSEE_ID = PP.CREATED_BY) OR (UF.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND UF.REQUESTER_ID = PP.CREATED_BY) ) ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES CS WHERE CS.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND CS.CONTENT_ID = PP.POST_ID AND CS.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(CS.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (CS.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR CS.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND ( (#{scopeType} = 'PERSONAL' AND CS.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND CS.TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'WORKSPACE' AND CS.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND CS.TARGET_ID = #{scopeId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS WSM WHERE WSM.WS_ID = CS.TARGET_ID AND WSM.USER_ID = #{userId})) OR (#{scopeType} = 'PROJECT' AND CS.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND CS.TARGET_ID = #{scopeId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS PM WHERE PM.PROJ_ID = CS.TARGET_ID AND PM.USER_ID = #{userId})) ) ) ) AND NVL(PP.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY PP.CREATED_AT DESC, PP.POST_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT FROM PHOTO_POSTS PP JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = PP.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN PHOTO_ALBUMS A ON A.ALBUM_ID = PP.ALBUM_ID WHERE PP.POST_ID = #{postId} AND NVL(PP.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N'

AND PP.DELETED_BY = #{userId}

SELECT P.PHOTO_ID, P.POST_ID, P.ALBUM_ID, P.FILE_PATH, P.ORIGINAL_NAME, P.FILE_SIZE, P.MIME_TYPE, P.UPLOADED_BY, U.USER_NAME AS UPLOADER_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM PHOTOS P JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = P.UPLOADED_BY WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY P.SORT_ORDER ASC, P.PHOTO_ID ASC

INSERT INTO PHOTO_POSTS ( POST_ID, SCOPE_TYPE, SCOPE_ID, ALBUM_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, VISIBILITY_TYPE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{albumId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{visibilityType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE PHOTO_POSTS SET ALBUM_ID = #{albumId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
UPDATE PHOTO_POSTS SET ALBUM_ID = #{albumId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
UPDATE PHOTO_POSTS SET VISIBILITY_TYPE = #{visibilityType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}

UPDATE PHOTO_POSTS PP SET PP.ORIGINAL_ALBUM_ID = PP.ALBUM_ID, PP.ALBUM_ID = NULL, PP.DELETED_YN = 'Y', PP.DELETED_AT = SYSDATE, PP.DELETED_BY = #{userId}, PP.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PP.POST_ID = #{postId} AND NVL(PP.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND ( PP.CREATED_BY = #{userId} OR (PP.SCOPE_TYPE = 'WORKSPACE' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES W WHERE W.WS_ID = PP.SCOPE_ID AND W.OWNER_ID = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS WM WHERE WM.WS_ID = PP.SCOPE_ID AND WM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(WM.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN') )) OR (PP.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PROJECT' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS P WHERE P.PROJ_ID = PP.SCOPE_ID AND P.LEADER_ID = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS PM WHERE PM.PROJ_ID = PP.SCOPE_ID AND PM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(PM.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN', 'LEADER', 'OWNER', 'PM')) )) )

UPDATE PHOTO_POSTS PP SET PP.ALBUM_ID = CASE WHEN PP.ORIGINAL_ALBUM_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PHOTO_ALBUMS A WHERE A.ALBUM_ID = PP.ORIGINAL_ALBUM_ID) THEN PP.ORIGINAL_ALBUM_ID ELSE NULL END, PP.ORIGINAL_ALBUM_ID = NULL, PP.DELETED_YN = 'N', PP.DELETED_AT = NULL, PP.DELETED_BY = NULL, PP.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PP.POST_ID = #{postId} AND NVL(PP.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND PP.DELETED_BY = #{userId}

ELSE C.COMMENT_CONTENT END AS COMMENT_CONTENT, NVL(C.DELETED_YN, 'N') AS DELETED_YN, U.USER_NAME, U.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(C.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN NVL(C.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS CR WHERE CR.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO_COMMENT' AND CR.CONTENT_ID = C.COMMENT_ID AND CR.REACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE' ) END AS LIKE_COUNT, CASE WHEN NVL(C.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE ( CASE WHEN #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS CR WHERE CR.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO_COMMENT' AND CR.CONTENT_ID = C.COMMENT_ID AND CR.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CR.REACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) END AS LIKED_BY_ME FROM PHOTO_POST_COMMENTS C JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND ( NVL(C.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PHOTO_POST_COMMENTS CC WHERE CC.POST_ID = C.POST_ID AND CC.PARENT_COMMENT_ID = C.COMMENT_ID AND NVL(CC.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' ) ) ORDER BY NVL(C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID, C.COMMENT_ID) ASC, CASE WHEN C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, C.CREATED_AT ASC, C.COMMENT_ID ASC
